corpusGroundTruthExtension.disclosure: Running the new detector over the existing 45-scenario corpus flagged 3 scenarios (I1, I2, I4) whose ground truth did not inventory the definitional lead-in ('X means, for any period, ...' / 'the ratio of') and, in I1, the 'without duplication and to the extent deducted in determining' condition. These are real components (the real holdout runs inventoried the equivalent heads as VALUE/OTHER items), so the corpus ground truth was EXTENDED with those items (and their lineage in compose) rather than weakening the detector. No detector threshold was tuned to make a scenario pass. No known-package ground truth was touched.
